messages:
noah: Quick ask for the webinar launch pack — need final assets for the live panel promo and followup downloads. Deliverables: webinar-hero (1200x628), speaker-slide-template (16:9 PPTX + PNG), three microtiles for social (square + story), localized copies for EN/DE/FR, and an inbound sticker with UTM-ready link. Deadline: Friday EOD.
devin: Copy that. Which visual direction are we using? the clean-graph look or illustration-led?
tara: Illustration-led pls for social, but hero should remain graph-first (we still want the bench sparkline visible). Speaker slides should be illustration accents + code snippet panel.
noah: Also animation note: 3s subtle sparkline draw for hero gif. Keep file-size <2MB for social. For animated gif export include a high-framerate MP4 fallback for the website.
devin: @designbot can you queue exports: PNG 1200x628, GIF 1200x628 (3s), MP4 1200x628 h264, PPTX template, SVG icons, and per-language PNGs (EN/DE/FR) for the three microtiles? Name outputs with suffixes: _en/_de/_fr.
designbot: Export request received by devin: project=figma://redwood/webinar-launch id=W456 frames=[webinar-hero,speaker-slide-template,microtile-a,microtile-b,microtile-c,inbound-sticker] variants=[default,animated-gif,mp4] locales=[en,de,fr] outputs=[png:1200x628,png:1080x1080,png:1080x1920,gif:1200x628,mp4:1200x628,pptx:16-9,svg]. ETA ~18m.
ryan: Legal note: marketing claims in German/French translations must match approved English copy. Please don't translate any percentages without legal review. Looping in @legal-ops for localization sign-off.
legal-ops: Important: any comparative claims need qualifiers ("up to", "median"). Provide source line: "internal benchmark vs baseline" and attach a short methodology doc. For non-English assets we'll need the exact translated strings before final approval.
tara: Understood. We'll provide the copy file with string keys so legal can review translations. I'll add keys: hero_headline, hero_subhead, micro_cta, sticker_link.
devin: For inbound sticker microcopy we want UTM: ?utm_source=webinar&utm_campaign=bench_launch&utm_medium=organic. Use short redirect: redwood.ai/w/bench. Also include mailto:sales@redwood.ai as backup.
noah: Accessibility: ensure animated GIF has a static PNG fallback and include ARIA label/caption for the MP4 on the site. Color contrast must meet AA.
designbot: Animation export complete. Files uploaded to /figma/webinar/exports/1769999998/: webinar-hero_en.gif, webinar-hero_en.mp4, speaker-slide-template_default.pptx, microtile-a_de.png, inbound-sticker_en.svg, etc. Public preview: https://figma.redwood/exports/1769999998/
devin: I'll drop localized copy spreadsheet to the marketing drive: https://docs.redwood/marketing/webinar-localization. Tara please populate translations by EOD Thu.
tara: Will do — using vendor X for FR/DE. Expect sheets by Thursday noon.
legal-ops: Once translations are in place we'll do a quick pass. Please flag any numeric claims separately for extra scrutiny.
ops: Distribution plan: confirm we want assets into the socials scheduler (Buffer) + sales enablement (GDrive) + web (static assets CDN). I can upload once we have final PNG/MP4 and localized variants.
noah: Yes ops please. Also share the PPTX with AE team (sales@redwood.ai) and add speaker notes with the demo link.
devin: Small ask: can the speaker PPTX include a hidden slide with model latency/cost bullets (non-claimey) for Q&A?
legal-ops: Hidden deck content still counts. Keep it factual and include source note. We can approve once wording provided.
ryan: Thanks team. If design files pass a11y + legal we'll schedule the promotional send for Monday. Closing loop after translations land.
